notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 2 will not be coming to Steam after all...
notes.notes: [p]Very sad news today. The second season of Tales From The Unending Void, which [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1224160/view/545604938652188730?l=english"]was planned for release this year[/url] has been rejected and banned by Steam after review. There are no appeals to this process, so I'm afraid this it the end of the franchise of three seasons on Steam. I'm looking at other storefronts like GOG to sell the remaining two seasons.[/p][p][/p][p]Some background to the whole process: I first submitted the second season game build in early July. The game build was approved apart from some technical matters (a mature content overview that needed updating and missing controller support) on July 13. After fixing those issues and resubmitting I got the final review today telling me that Steam has decided not to publish the second season due to "themes, imagery or descriptions that we won’t distribute".[/p][p][/p][p]I can imagine that you have been looking forward to continuing the story of Camran and his crew. While the game won't be available on Steam, all of the game builds are cross-compatible. So if you download or buy the game elsewhere, you'll be able to continue where you've left off. When alternative options of purchasing the game become available I'll be sure to let you know.[/p]

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season Two will release this year!
notes.notes:
[b]It's happening! [/b]

Tales From The Unending Void: Season Two will release here on Steam this year. The last episode of the season is currently in active development and once it's finished the entire season will be published on Steam.

Season Two picks up after the finale of the first season and you'll be able to continue the adventures of the Iron Bastard's crew. The second season contains episode 13 through 22 and includes bonus sex scenes, an updated walkthrough and extra artwork.

Please be sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612990/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_2]wishlist the game[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612990/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_2

[b]Release Date[/b]
Once development of Episode 22 is finished and everything is ready to be published on Steam, I will announce the final release date of the second season.

[b]Separate game vs. DLC[/b]
The second season is a standalone game, but you'll be able to import your end-of-season season from Season One, which will carry over the choices you've made. Alternatively there's the option to fill out a short questionnaire where you'll be able to select the most important choices. Releasing the game as DLC is something I've investigated, but the technical implications of this scenario (maintaining localizations and code interoperability across versions) made me decide against going this route.

notes.title: Tales From The Unending Void: Season 1: v0.12.2 (Quickfix)
notes.notes:
This quickfix should fix a missing variable error that occurred for some players near the end of the game.

Beware though that saves right before the error will still be affected by the bug. To remedy this you can do the following:

- Load save right before the error
- Open the developer console by pressing Shift+O
- Type the following and press enter: [code]$ ep005_taera_body=False[/code]

notes.title: Meet the crew
notes.notes:
With Tales From The Unending Void releasing in little over one week, I though it would be nice to introduce the girls that will make up a large part of your crew in the game. Will you romance everyone, or just pursue that one special girl?

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/089868ec76283f10c568404030049dcbfedb3e2e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/e7e55bed6935d88a7714ea20d11947b18d38aa2b.png[/img][/url]
[h3]LILLY[/h3]
Your redheaded younger sister and you don't always get along, but she manages to surprise you every now and then.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/0eb66596b4bbb1b3c46b57946afcbda5aa609194.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/78fb4ab2ecc4ffe36d2ab5f6cf1883461af7ac7e.png[/img][/url]
[h3]EVA[/h3]
In many ways the opposite to Lilly, a sweet and soft-spoken girl and just as intelligent as her twin sister.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/bd05b5821e0f7f5026bf08b827a9927d952389ea.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/0e4e29bd06ef307a200442c44f47aef239e0a8c8.png[/img][/url]
[h3]AVEN[/h3]
Before your cousin was taken away suddenly, Aven was your childhood playmate and a friend you shared everything with.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/d86b931828ace2d139e71ed447bfd501bad958f9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/d5dc74be8262bcd34c0148f99ffd95dcd545cef7.png[/img][/url]
[h3]NADYA[/h3]
Aunt Nadya, a xenobiology professor, was a continued presence in your youth, until she suddenly left your childhood home, taking Aven with her.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/37e91991e8a07b6a4abc75f3b905b08f02559404.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/a7f44f5358f420fcb4a73c7619affde200e73f25.png[/img][/url]
[h3]JADE[/h3]
Formerly a Twi'll princess, Jade is now your personal attendant and takes care of your every (yes, every) need.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/be036e302dd9f797cec19112925287696b60274d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/f1c10289f37d65b949ccb26f16eb6d206a613f38.png[/img][/url]
[h3]THYIA[/h3]
A skilled mechanic with a fiercely independent streak.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/5eb439cf2a902674a9ef179130ee669e5fa3450d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/b82fe4533648f228f99588b6d5c02c7ffdbecce1.png[/img][/url]
[h3]ZIV[/h3]
A Rhenkoy who joins the crew with her ward Raene.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/7178058963f34eaf487baa406f6ab51f1f792028.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/036ae7ff179c13ab52cdf454ce19b015d4490cef.png[/img][/url]
[h3]RAENE[/h3]
Shy and very introverted, Raene joins the ship's crew with her friend Ziv.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/b9f7236a0e059e9bfb5ce3b1e17eef05d767e7df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/d36a1a7675485d93bebb3f725a55d105fa6300fd.png[/img][/url]
[h3]CÉLINE[/h3]
Sister of Kit and friends with both of your sisters. She has a crush on you too...

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/2731bca32f71ad521d7dca9bbbbc086d7e9d8659.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42195608/398abe61b9427b133d0a88ab468adc3dc44735a6.png[/img][/url]

A damsel in distress who lost her family during a raid on Lanan.

Now, everything is ready for the official release on May 2. I'd be honored if you spread the word and put the game on your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858500/Tales_From_The_Unending_Void_Season_1

Tales From The Unending Void is my next project after Sisterly Lust. While it shares many of the mechanics and kinks found in Sisterly Lust, my new game is set far into the future. 

[h2]Story[/h2]
Camran is a young minor noble from the Sovereignty, a part of space dominated by humans. Erstwhile cadet of the Terran Naval Academy, Cam has been forced by circumstances to travel the galaxy, together with a band of friends, taking on menial jobs and occasionally smuggling some illicit cargo. As he involuntarily becomes part of sinister plans machinated by powerful intrigants, Camran’s life is changed forever…

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Season One contains Episode 1 through 12 with two remaining seasons to be released as DLC
[*] Over 5000 renders
[*] Over 250 animations enhancing the many erotic scenes in the game
[*] Hours of branching story, offering replayability
[*] Rich and atmospheric soundtrack
[*] Scene replay for all sex scenes
[*] Codex detailing the various characters, species, planets and places in the game
[*] 60 achievements
[*] Official English Game guide (press the "Bonus" button in the game's main menu)
[*] Bonus artwork featuring the many women in the game (press the "Bonus" button in the game's main menu)
[/list]
